title: Gusts
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels where the wind changes over time. In the first, a gust blows up a shaft of air and lifts Kit to a ledge too high to jump to: wait in the shaft and ride it. In the second, gusts blow along a tunnel and push him back, and two little shelters are a place to wait. A gust here is a ring of blocks that pull, changing on a timer. Signs say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change how long a gust lasts.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie has two short rooms where the wind comes and goes. Leaves flutter before a gust lifts him up a shaft. Windsocks show the gusts along a tunnel, and a shelter is a place to wait. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change how long a gust lasts.
features: A shaft of air that flutters, then lifts you to a high ledge
Windsocks that droop, twitch and stream in step with the wind
Little shelters to wait in, with a coin or two
Made to be copied and taken apart
